svg.aria-label: Tools compared on the same tasks: a row per tool for each task, with the share of its runs that passed, the median time, and the median uncached input, peak context, cost per run and seconds the user was disturbed.
svg.title: Tools compared on the same tasks: a row per tool for each task, with the share of its runs that passed, the median time, and the median uncached input, peak context, cost per run and seconds the user was disturbed.
svg.text: Tools compared on the same tasks
The first bar is the share of runs that passed, with the count and the passed runs' median time. The other
bars have a scale each: tokens and cost are medians over all runs. User disturbed counts the passed runs
that took the focus or drew over the user's window, and its bar is their median seconds.
Each row pools the runs of every agent.
